summary: Independent review reconstructed the sample-to-file mapping, varieties, locations and technical replicates from the deposited y16_design.tsv and Proteios y16_data.tsv header and found all 131 rows consistent; validator and helper checks clean. Only minor findings remain.

reviewer_context.context: fresh reviewer subagent without producer transcript; producer report treated as untrusted

spec_compliance.evidence: 131 rows x 31 columns; templates ms-proteomics v1.1.0 + plants v1.1.0 declared and appropriate (Solanum tuberosum leaf, label-free MS). plants-required developmental stage and disease present (not available); reserved words correctly spelled; sdrf-tools structure OK; no duplicate assay names or data files.

ontology_integrity.evidence: Resolved in local OLS cache: NCBITaxon:4113 solanum tuberosum; BTO:0000713 leaf; MS:1002416 orbitrap fusion; MS:1001251 trypsin; MS:1002038 label free sample; PRIDE:0000627 data-dependent acquisition; PRIDE:0000608 dithiothreitol (DTT); PRIDE:0000599 iodoacetamide (IAA); UNIMOD:4 carbamidomethyl, UNIMOD:35 oxidation, UNIMOD:1 acetyl. Labels and accessions match; sdrf-tools check --offline CLEAN.

source_evidence.evidence: PRIDE record: organism potato, organism part leaf, Orbitrap Fusion, DTT/IAA reduction-alkylation, trypsin in-gel digestion, MS-GF+/X!Tandem search. X!Tandem input parameters: 57.021464@C fixed, 15.994915@M variable, refinement +42.010565@[ (protein N-term), 10 ppm / 0.4 Da. For every row, variety == design 'variety', location (Umea/Borgeby) == design 'location', source name == potato_sample_<design sample>, technical replicate == design 'rerun'. Umea (northern) vs Borgeby (southern Sweden) matches abstract framing. sdrf-tools reconcile: all values agree with deposit record.

file_mapping.evidence: files_compact.json has 131 RAW files; y16_data.tsv header maps 131 ns_* sample names to 131 mzML stems, all identical to RAW stems; every SDRF assay name maps to exactly the header-designated RAW (0 mismatches), 131 unique data files, no missing or extra RAW, no non-raw files.

design_consistency.evidence: 95 sources = design samples 1..95 with no gaps; 33 rerun=2 and 3 rerun=3 injections as technical replicates (131 rows). Per-source characteristics are constant. Biological replicate numbering is 1..n contiguous within each of 26 variety x location groups. Factors growth condition (2 levels) and strain or breed (19 levels) match design; unbalanced (only 7 varieties at Borgeby) is a property of the study, not an error.

omission_safety.evidence: No unsupported specificity: developmental stage and disease left as not available; month/date/time correctly recognised as 2017 acquisition timestamps (plants grown 2016) and not annotated as sample attributes; yield/supergroup design columns are derived groupings and not required. Omissions noted below are minor/optional.

deterministic_validation.evidence: flock ... parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -t ms-proteomics -t plants --use_ols_cache_only: 'Everything seems to be fine', exit 0. sdrf-tools check --offline exit 0 CLEAN; score 100/100 exit 0; structure OK exit 0; reconcile against pride.json exit 0, all values agree.

findings.location: characteristics[strain or breed] / factor value[strain or breed] values 'KingEdward', 'SarpoMira'
findings.message: Cultivar names copied from design codes without spaces; canonical cultivar names are 'King Edward' and 'Sarpo Mira'.

findings.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance], comment[fragment mass tolerance], comment[modification parameters]
findings.message: Tolerances and modifications are taken from X!Tandem only; MS-GF+ settings (also used per PRIDE data processing protocol) are unverified, and missed cleavages (1) is not recorded.
findings.evidence: xtandem_input_parameters.txt; PRIDE dataProcessingProtocol names MS-GF+ and X!Tandem.

findings.message: Design column 'batch_column_switch' (LC column batch 1: 43 runs, 2: 88 runs) is not recorded, and Svante_85min_1.raw (ns_1, acquired June 2017, name suggests an 85 min gradient) differs from the Sep-Nov 2017 runs; consider optional comment columns so downstream users can model the batch.
